sources: Codex Q4 states the same boundary without classifying it as a finding
findings.defect: The F_one SHA 374d6fb4..., the header bytes "p cnf 509915 5740226\n" and "p cnf 509915 5740268\n" and all 16 leaf SHAs are computed only by the producer Formula class (PROD:33,38) and re-observed in the same process by VER (VER:40 compares f.sha with a constant; VER:90 calls f.leaf_sha). RCPT:16,18 are string literals written by VER:99-100. VER re-reads DEL without re-hashing it (VER:42; PROD:45 hashed it once in-process), never compares the rebuilt recipe r with BASE_RECIPE, RECIPE:46-47 are hard-coded True (PROD:80-81), and VER:1 calls itself an "Independent traversal check". The genuinely second-path checks are the body traversal, source header/CR/comment checks, the 4 deleted and Q1 hashes, the name-table domains and the unit reconstruction (VER:43-89). CL1:89 asked for an independently streamed F_one SHA pinned beforehand; that was not done.
findings.correction: Reword OVL:86 and LINK:19: "second-path body traversal and unit reconstruction; header bytes, F_one SHA and leaf SHAs recomputed only by the producer Formula (same code path)". Gate 5 regeneration must recompute sha256(header + retained body + "%d 0\n" units) with an independent implementation and compare with every WMAN cnf_sha256 (or a VER v2 doing so with its own hashlib, also asserting sha256(DEL) and RECIPE == r).
